duplicate_policy: Report duplicates and lineage; do not automatically launch extra sampling.

symmetry.point_group_claim: No C4 assumption; explicit sequence-equivalence ties only.

postgeneration_requirements: Release contact restraints for noncovalent validation
Use confidence/geometry/strain/interface metrics descriptively until calibrated

separate_future_ideas: NylB/polyMAXA-to-MAXA selectivity; explicit product mapping and institutional IP review needed

Human-reviewed mechanism-agent workflow; autonomous chemistry planning unqualified

host_priority: Preserve current QM/MM, US and WT MD; run accepted 24-sample pilot; automatic matched WT analysis after MD; no new mechanism or LLM campaigns.
